# kion_project_note (Resource)

Manages a Kion Project Note.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_project_note" "example" {
  # Required
  create_user_id = 1

  # Optional
  # name       = "example"
  # project_id = 1
  # text       = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `create_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who created the note.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the note.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `text` (String) Body text of the note.

### Read-Only

- `create_user_name` (String) Name of the user who created the note.
- `created_at` (String) When the note was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the project note.
- `last_update_user_id` (Number) ID of the user who last updated the note.
- `last_update_user_name` (String) Name of the user who last updated the note.
- `updated_at` (String) When the note was last updated.
